w1005-b-s01.mp3: My neck and shoulders feel stiff often, because I work at a desk and spend all day looking at a monitor.
w1005-b-s02.mp3: On days when I really get stressed out, the back of my neck gets especially tense.
w1005-b-s03.mp3: Sometimes the pain is even worse after I wake up.
w1005-b-s04.mp3: So, I’ve tried several different pillows to find one that works well for me.
w1005-b-s05.mp3: There were all kinds of pillows, including ones that firmly support the neck, soft memory foam pillows, and pillows designed for people who sleep on their side.
w1005-b-s06.mp3: I tried products from famous brands and pillows endorsed by celebrities.
w1005-b-s07.mp3: But I learned that it’s more important to lie down on the pillow yourself and find the right height and material for your body type and sleeping habits.
w1005-b-s08.mp3: These days, part of me wants to keep using the pillow I’m using now.
w1005-b-s09.mp3: But I also can’t help being interested whenever a new product comes out, because the right pillow can make a big difference in getting a good night’s sleep and keeping your neck healthy.

w20260914-b-s01.mp3: Five years before reaching retirement age, I decided to retire early.
w20260914-b-s02.mp3: I wanted to give myself five bonus years as a reward for all the hard work I had done.
w20260914-b-s04.mp3: As soon as I retired, I set a long-term goal for myself.
w20260914-b-s05.mp3: By the time I turned 65, I wanted to be able to travel abroad freely.
w20260914-b-s06.mp3: My daughter recommended EBS English programs around that time, and I’ve been listening to them ever since.
w20260914-b-s07.mp3: Thanks to that, I was able to walk the 800-kilometer Camino de Santiago twice with two friends.
w20260914-b-s08.mp3: Along the way, I struck up conversations with many people from other countries.
w20260914-b-s09.mp3: One man from the UK even told me, “You’re talking with me right now.
w20260914-b-s11.mp3: Of course, there were times when I fell into a slump.
w20260914-b-s12.mp3: But I always treated English as a hobby and kept at it.
w20260914-b-s13.mp3: Of all the programs, “입트영” lets me indirectly experience many different people’s lives through their stories, and it always motivates me to keep going.

w20260921-b-s02.mp3: One of my hobbies is searching for restaurant recommendations on social media and saving places I want to try on a map app.
w20260921-b-s03.mp3: My foodie map is organized by city, including Seoul, Busan, and Jeju.
w20260921-b-s04.mp3: I have dozens or even hundreds of restaurants saved for each area.
w20260921-b-s05.mp3: I don’t have any limits for the restaurant’s type or size, from local eateries to hotel buffets.
w20260921-b-s06.mp3: Whenever I travel to a particular area, I open my food map and happily start deciding where to eat.
w20260921-b-s07.mp3: When I find a new restaurant to try, I carefully check reviews and photos from people who have actually been there.
w20260921-b-s08.mp3: After reading so many reviews, I’ve developed an eye for knowing whether a post is genuine or sponsored, based on the way it’s written.
w20260921-b-s09.mp3: The hundreds of restaurants saved on my map are like a treasure to me.
w20260921-b-s10.mp3: Every day, I enjoy adding new restaurants to my collection one by one.

w20261012-b-s01.mp3: Our family visits a natural recreation forest in the country about once a month.
w20261012-b-s02.mp3: Every month, we can make reservations and enter a lottery through a government-run website.
w20261012-b-s03.mp3: Popular places often fill up as soon as reservations open at 9 a.m.
w20261012-b-s04.mp3: Sometimes we get lucky and win a spot that someone else canceled.
w20261012-b-s05.mp3: By touring these natural recreation forests, we get to travel around the country with our kids and experience what makes each region special.
w20261012-b-s06.mp3: We taste local specialties and visit traditional markets, where we enjoy the warm hospitality.
w20261012-b-s07.mp3: Sometimes we’re also lucky enough to see a local festival.
w20261012-b-s08.mp3: At the forests, we can enjoy forest activities and go on walks.
w20261012-b-s10.mp3: We go to these places to make memories for the sake of our children, but I’m also grateful that we get to spend time together this way.
w20261012-b-s11.mp3: The prices are reasonable, and there are so many different things to experience.
w20261012-b-s12.mp3: I would recommend these natural recreation forests to anyone.
